source_meta._title: Shulker boxes drop their contents when broken

stor.environment: Minecraft: Java Edition snapshot 25w02a, unmodified vanilla client, singleplayer world, Survival mode at the trigger, keyboard and mouse controls. Use a newly created world with commands enabled solely to acquire deterministic test items; no specific seed, coordinates, difficulty, dimension, datapack, resource pack, or server configuration is specified by the report.
preconditions: Install and launch the exact affected snapshot 25w02a. Do not use fix version 25w03a or a newer version.
Use an unmodified vanilla instance without datapacks or mods that replace shulker box loot tables or container behavior.
Create or load a singleplayer world in which commands are enabled. The player must be in Survival mode before breaking the shulker box.
Ensure there is accessible solid ground with enough open space above it for a shulker box to open.
Ensure the player inventory has at least four free slots for one shulker box, one iron pickaxe, and two stacks of test contents.

steps.action: Launch Minecraft: Java Edition using the 25w02a installation and verify the version shown on the title screen before opening a world.
steps.success_cue: The title screen identifies the running game version as 25w02a.

steps.action: From the title screen, select Singleplayer, then Create New World. Set the game mode to Survival, enable commands or cheats, and create the world. The seed and other world-generation settings may remain at their defaults. Wait for terrain to render and for movement to respond normally.
steps.success_cue: The player is standing in a loaded singleplayer world, movement responds normally, and the Survival health and hunger bars are visible.

steps.action: Open in-game chat and give the player one empty shulker box. Include the leading slash because this command is being entered through in-game chat.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that one shulker box was given, and the shulker box is present in the player inventory or hotbar.

steps.action: Open in-game chat and give the player one new, unenchanted iron pickaxe to serve as the proper mining tool.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that one iron pickaxe was given, and an iron pickaxe is present in the player inventory or hotbar.

steps.action: Open in-game chat and give the player one stack of cobblestone as the first arbitrary item stack to store in the shulker box.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that 64 cobblestone were given, and the stack is present in the player inventory or hotbar.

steps.action: Open in-game chat and give the player one stack of dirt as the second arbitrary item stack to store in the shulker box.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that 64 dirt were given, and the stack is present in the player inventory or hotbar.

steps.action: Press E to open the inventory. Locate the shulker box and iron pickaxe, then drag the shulker box into hotbar slot 1 and the iron pickaxe into hotbar slot 2. Leave the cobblestone and dirt anywhere in the player inventory. Press E or Esc to close the inventory.
steps.exact_input: E; drag Shulker Box to hotbar slot 1; drag Iron Pickaxe to hotbar slot 2; E or Esc
steps.success_cue: The closed inventory view shows the shulker box in hotbar slot 1 and the iron pickaxe in hotbar slot 2.

steps.action: Press 1 to select the shulker box in hotbar slot 1. Aim the crosshair at the top face of a nearby solid ground block with open space above it, then right-click once to place the shulker box.
steps.success_cue: A closed shulker box block is visible on the ground in front of the player.

steps.action: Keep the crosshair aimed at the placed shulker box and right-click it once to open its container interface.
steps.success_cue: The shulker box interface is open, showing an upper storage grid of 27 slots and the player inventory below it.

steps.action: In the open shulker box interface, locate the stack of 64 cobblestone in the lower player-inventory area. Hold Shift and left-click that stack once to transfer it into the shulker box storage grid.
steps.success_cue: A stack of 64 cobblestone is visible in one of the upper shulker box storage slots.

steps.action: Locate the stack of 64 dirt in the lower player-inventory area. Hold Shift and left-click that stack once to transfer it into the shulker box storage grid.
steps.success_cue: The upper shulker box storage grid contains both the cobblestone stack and the dirt stack.

steps.action: Press Esc to close the shulker box interface. Remain near the box and wait until its lid-closing animation has completely finished before continuing.
steps.success_cue: First-person world view is restored and the placed shulker box lid is visually fully closed.

steps.action: Explicitly set the player to Survival mode immediately before the mining test. Press T to open chat, enter the command with its leading slash, and press Enter.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback confirms Survival mode, and the health and hunger bars are visible above the hotbar.

steps.action: Press 2 to select the unenchanted iron pickaxe in hotbar slot 2. Aim the crosshair directly at the closed shulker box and stand close enough that its block outline appears when targeted.
steps.success_cue: The iron pickaxe is visible in the player's main hand and the closed, filled shulker box is targeted by the crosshair.

steps.action: Hold the left mouse button continuously to mine the targeted shulker box with the iron pickaxe. Release the button as soon as the block finishes breaking. Do not move toward or pick up any resulting item entities before handing control to the observation subsystem.
steps.exact_input: Hold left mouse button until the shulker box block breaks, then release
steps.success_cue: The shulker box block has completed its breaking action and no longer occupies its placed block position; the player has not moved to collect anything.

stor.handoff_condition: The closed, non-empty shulker box has just been mined to completion in Survival mode with an unenchanted iron pickaxe, and the player remains stationary before collecting any resulting item entities. Begin observation immediately.
uncertainties: The report does not specify a world seed, coordinates, dimension, difficulty, or multiplayer requirement; this plan uses a new singleplayer world and arbitrary accessible solid ground.

The report says to fill the box with random content but does not identify particular items or quantities. This plan deterministically uses one full stack of cobblestone and one full stack of dirt as arbitrary contents.

The report describes only a proper tool without naming it. A pickaxe was selected because shulker boxes are identified as pickaxe-mineable; the report does not require a particular pickaxe material or enchantment.

Commands and enabled cheats are not stated reproduction requirements. They are used only to acquire the test items deterministically while keeping the actual placement, filling, and breaking sequence in Survival mode.

No requirement is given to reproduce the separate piston or explosion duplication variant mentioned in a comment; this plan covers only the primary report procedure of manually mining the shulker box with a proper tool.
